verses.en: In the name of Allah, the Gracious, the Merciful.
[✲]Convey thou in the name of thy Lord Who created,
[✲]Created man from a clot of blood.
[✲]Convey! And thy Lord is Most Generous,
[✲]Who taught man by the pen,
Taught man what he knew not.
Nay! man does indeed transgress,
Because he thinks himself to be independent.
Surely, unto thy Lord is the return.
Hast thou seen him who forbids
A servant of Ours when he prays?
[✲]Tell me if he (Our servant) follows the guidance
[✲]Or enjoins righteousness, what will be the end of the forbidder?
w: righteousness, what will be the end of the forbidder

verses.en: [✲]Tell me if he (the forbidder) rejects and turns his back,
[✲]Does he not know that Allah sees him?

verses.ar: کَلَّا لَئِنۡ لَّمۡ یَنۡتَہِ ۬ۙ لَنَسۡفَعًۢا بِالنَّاصِیَۃِ ﴿ۙ۱۶﴾
verses.en: [✲]Nay, if he desist not, We will assuredly seize and drag him by the forelock,
w: We will assuredly seize and drag him

verses.en: [✲]A forelock lying, sinful.
[✲]Then let him call his associates,
We too will call Our angels of punishment who will thrust him into Hell.
w: Our angels of punishment who will thrust him into Hell

verses.en: Nay, yield not thou to him, but prostrate thyself and draw near to God.
